name: Aegis pest Detection Rover
summary: An autonomous rover that patrols a farm plot and uses computer vision to detect soil and crop pests. Each time a pest is identified, it sends an instant alert to the owner's phone via Telegram, enabling timely, targeted intervention and reducing crop losses.
description:
Aegis autonomously scans a farm plot, using a computer vision algorithm to identify soil and crop pests as it moves. Each detection sends a notification straight to the owner's phone on Telegram, so action can be taken before the damage spreads.

Pests are often spotted too late, after the harvest is already at risk. Aegis patrols the plot consistently, replacing occasional manual inspection with regular, reliable coverage.
